macos_arm64_release.tested_source: Pinned f7e5842 plus the committed folder-conflict regression and volume-refresh source changes; changed source bytes matched the repository and both source manifests were verified after building

macos_native_pty.scope: Real macOS controlling terminal with keyboard input to the verified product process
checks: Right accepts a displayed completion in the location editor; Enter navigates exactly to the proposed directory.
F4 switches working panes, and Insert marks an entry independently in each pane.
A new file inserts above the left mark; Ctrl+R keeps the mark and green focus on the unchanged original file, and the right-pane mark stays selected.
Resize retains both marks. Alt+X exits cleanly, restores termios and terminal private modes, and leaves no Files process.

verified: Esc during first-time volume enumeration cancels that scan and preserves the filesystem listing.
Esc during a refresh discards the eventual reply, keeps the selected mount and its previous capacity visible, and reports that the retained information is stale.
Leaving the volume view through Parent still reopens the namespace root in the same pane.
